command:
set +e
set -uo pipefail
# spawn runs task commands under bash -e; `set -uo pipefail` does not clear it (spawn#707).
export TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1
cd /tmp
echo "== staged bytes must match their pins =="
T0=$(date +%s)
sha256sum -c pins.sha256 || { echo "FAIL: a staged input does not match its pin"; exit 1; }
( cd axes && sha256sum -c ../axes.sha256 > /dev/null ) || { echo "FAIL: the staged axes do not match axes.sha256"; exit 1; }
echo "pins ok in $(( $(date +%s) - T0 ))s"
W=$(getconf _NPROCESSORS_ONLN)
{ echo "arch $(uname -m)"; echo "cpus $W"; grep -m1 -E 'model name|CPU part' /proc/cpuinfo; echo "threads_per_core $(awk -F, '{print NF}' /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu0/topology/thread_siblings_list)"; grep MemTotal /proc/meminfo; python3 -c 'import sys,cftime,numpy,xarray,numcodecs; print("python",sys.version.split()[0],"cftime",getattr(cftime,"__version__","unknown"),"numpy",numpy.__version__,"xarray",xarray.__version__,"numcodecs",numcodecs.__version__)'; } > host.txt 2>&1
cat host.txt
T0=$(date +%s)
python3 -u decode.py axes out "$W" > decode.log 2>&1
RC=$?
cat decode.log
echo "decode.py exit $RC in $(( $(date +%s) - T0 ))s"
cp host.txt out/
test "$RC" = 0 || { echo "FAIL: the decode failed"; exit 1; }
python3 -u check.py pangeo-cmip6.csv.gz out > check.log 2>&1
RC=$?
cat check.log
test "$RC" = 0 || { echo "FAIL: a check failed"; exit 1; }
grep -q 'CFTIME REAL OK' check.log || { echo "FAIL: no completion sentinel"; exit 1; }
gzip -n out/stores.jsonl out/vars.jsonl
df -h /tmp | tail -1
echo DONE
